name: vscode-colorize
description: Visualize CSS colors in your files, now with first-class Lua and FiveM support.

colorize.languages.description: Language identifiers in which colors are decorated. Lua is enabled by default.

colorize.files.description: Glob patterns for additional files to colorize. This is the original Colorize option.

colorize.files_extensions.description: File extensions supported in addition to language identifiers. Kept for compatibility with Colorize.

colorize.colorized_colors.description: Color syntaxes to display. The legacy Colorize setting is preserved and extended with LUA and FIVEM.

colorize.colorized_variables.description: Variable families whose references can inherit a detected color.

colorize.enable_search_variables.description: Colorize references to CSS custom properties, Sass variables and Less variables.

colorize.hide_current_line_decorations.description: Hide decorations on the active line.

colorize.lua.enableTables.description: Colorize Lua tables assigned to a color-like key, for example color = { 255, 0, 0, 200 }.

colorize.lua.enableFiveM.description: Colorize FiveM caret codes (^1) and ~ color codes (~r~) inside Lua strings.
